items.title: SINCERITY
items.quote: Judge me, Hashem for I walked in my own innocence.
items.text: Prepare yourself to be judged by Hashem. This means that even though your actions are not what they should be, at least you have been sincere with Hashem and honest with yourself about serving Him and doing what is right.

items.title: SELF-EXAMINATION
items.quote: Examine me, Hashem. Test me; purify my conscience and my heart.
items.text: Ask Hashem to help you analyze the sincerity and honesty of your thoughts. Examine yourself to identify any hidden personal agenda that is undermining your eagerness to do the will of Hashem.

items.title: HASHEM’S KINDNESS
items.quote: For Your kindness is before my eyes.
items.text: Think about all the kindnesses that Hashem does for you every day and ask yourself about whether you can improve your efforts at showing gratitude by doing His will.

items.title: BAD INFLUENCES
items.quote: I have not sat down with idlers; I did not come into the company of hypocrites.
items.text: Avoid people who might weaken your resolve to always do what is right.

items.quote: I hated a community of evildoers; I did not sit with the wicked.

items.title: TESHUVAH
items.quote: I will wash my hands with purity.
items.text: Cleanse yourself through teshuvah so that you will be worthy of serving Hashem.

items.title: PUBLIC THANKS
items.quote: to proclaim aloud gratitude and to tell of all Your wonders.
items.text: Demonstrate the enthusiasm of your gratitude by publicly proclaiming the wonders you have seen and experienced.

items.title: LOVE
items.quote: Hashem, I love the shelter of Your House and the dwelling place of Your glory.
items.text: You should feel a sense of love and affection upon entering Hashem’s house, for it is there you will be closer to Him.

items.quote: As for me, I will walk in my innocence.
I will bless Hashem in public assemblies.
